svg.title: GRU953 — horizontal lockup with the tagline
svg.desc: The GRU953 Soaring Bird: a climbing bird drawn in fine lines, its wing fanned into four facets. The GRU953 wordmark, set in Sora at weight 700 and converted to outlines. The tagline in both languages: "Simple technology. For everyone." and "সহজ প্রযুক্তি। সবার জন্য।"
